exceptions.cause: The suite puts yfinance's tz cache in tempfile.mkdtemp(); on Windows %TEMP% is inside the user's home, so the test's 'not under home' assumption fails. Test assumption only.

reproduction.phase1a_result: fails on every local run of every PR head (deterministic)

exceptions.removal_path: upstream fix (assert against tempfile.gettempdir() instead of Path.home()) or an upstream sync that changes the test

exceptions.cause: Concurrent writers replacing the shared memory-log file on Windows occasionally get ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED (winerror 5 / errno 13) while another handle holds the file; the raising writer stops, so only its remaining entries are absent.

reproduction.pristine_result: 5/30 runs failed (2026-10-04, structured evidence); earlier text-based run 2/15. In every failure all collected errors were PermissionError(13, winerror 5) and only the raising writers were incomplete
reproduction.phase1a_result: earlier text-based run on Phase 1A code 4/15; structured reproduction on main+PR#5 recorded in the PR #5 validation log
